lines.trans: Well, how do you like the new head chef?
She seems a bit boring to me.
On the other hand she is calm and polite.
That is true, she never yells.
With her the kitchen is quiet and pleasant.
Slackers! Scraps! What are you doing?
I returned to restore complete order!
Chef, we were just cleaning the fish.
We are very glad to see you!
Stop chatting and take your knives!
Who permitted you to stand idle?
We will chop everything right now, chef.
Get to work quickly, lively!
